title: Crop Cultivation Handbook & POP
summary_lines: 1. Select fertile, well-drained loam or medium black soil with pH 6.5 to 7.5.
2. Transplant 45-day nursery seedlings on raised beds with drip irrigation.
3. Balance organic compost with recommended split basal NPK application.
steps: 1. Treat seedling roots in Carbendazim + Chlorpyriphos solution before transplanting.
2. Provide light irrigation every 3 to 4 days through drip system.
3. Carry out timely shallow weeding within the first 30 days of establishment.
speak_text: For successful rabi crop cultivation, prepare raised beds with well-decomposed manure and follow recommended seedling spacing.
